sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<40:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("start:",snap())
for i in range(12):
    res=action(['UP'])
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP at",i,{k:res.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over')}); break
    print(i+1, snap())
print("final lc:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
